First, I need to break down each component. Request routing involves how requests are directed to different parts of the system. Maybe using a queuing system like a FIFO or priority queue. Queueing would handle incoming requests, and tail latency refers to the time a request takes to be processed. Cache transfer is about data moving between cache and main memory, which affects latency. Role switching might involve different workers handling different tasks, which affects GPU utilization. Batch completion is about how many requests are processed in a batch, and throughput tradeoffs are about balancing processing speed with resource usage.
